Label.text: A border patrol recon pilot. A malfunctioning food synthesizer.
And a very wrong turn on the way to some much-needed R&R.
Instead of the Stratocaster facility, you have landed in the Maelstrom:
the Hormel asteroid belt between United Planet and Shenobi space.
Your plasma cannons and force shield are all that stand between
you and the rocks, mines, vortices, and Shenobi fleet ships ahead.
Collect supplies. Rescue stranded pilots. Keep moving.
Now you are in the middle of it, with just your luck to see you through.
Abridged for this personal edition. Press O for the original story.
